community.body: The elite athlete trains next to the regular Joe. The sub-elite gets coached the same way professionals are. The mum dropping off her kid feels welcomed, not out of place. The dad who's never trained a day in his life gets a coach who actually cares — not a machine and a locker room.
community.sloganTop: You Don't Have to Be an Athlete

audiences.title: The Aspiring Athlete
audiences.desc: Same methods. Same science. Same physio. Same dietitian as the pros. We will close the gap — no shortcuts, no guesswork. Just the work that actually gets you there.

audiences.title: The Regular Adult
audiences.desc: You don't need to be an athlete to train like one. Our coaches meet you exactly where you are — no judgment, no guesswork, no being left alone with a machine. Proper coaching. Proper results.

audiences.title: The Parent
audiences.desc: Your kid deserves real coaching — not a certificate holder running drills. We build confident, capable kids who actually want to train. Whether they're a budding athlete or just getting started.

Built for your body, your goals, your level.

classes.body: Small groups. Elite coaches. A program built around you. Challenging enough to make you better. Welcoming enough to make you stay.

items.name: Youth Classes
items.desc: Real coaching. Real development. Our LTAD approach builds athleticism through age appropriate structure, movement freedom, and skill development. No adult drills forced onto kids. Just smart coaching that develops confidence, coordination, creativity, and long term resilience.

items.name: Adult Classes
items.desc: A real coach. A real program. A room full of people working just as hard as you. Challenging enough to change you. Personal enough to keep you coming back. This is training that actually works.

items.name: ANY GOAL - ANY AGE
items.desc: Private coaching for every age and goal. From youth athletes to elite performers and everyday adults, our experienced coaches deliver individualised training built around your needs. Big goals or small wins, we help you move, perform, and progress better.

items.name: Athlete Programs
items.desc: Same methods. Same science. Same physio and dietitian as the pros. If you're chasing a contract, a squad spot, or simply the best version of yourself — this is where the gap gets closed.

items.name: Strength Training
items.desc: Progressive overload built for every body. Barbell fundamentals through advanced periodisation — science-led and coach-guided every session.

items.name: Speed & Agility
items.desc: Acceleration, deceleration, and change of direction — built around your sport. Sprint mechanics, video feedback, stride refinement and ground contact work woven into every block. Run faster. Last longer. Stay injury-free.

items.name: Conditioning
items.desc: Aerobic capacity and anaerobic power — measured, programmed and progressively overloaded. Never guesswork.

items.name: Testing & Screening
items.desc: Hawkin Dynamics force plates. Full physio screening. Every member, every time. No guesswork — just a clear, safe pathway from where you are to where you want to be.

items.name: Pilates
items.desc: Core control, breath work and precision movement that complements heavy training and builds long-term injury resilience.

items.name: Mobility & Recovery
items.desc: Structured routines that keep joints healthy and training uninterrupted — for the long haul, not just next week.

items.name: Allied Health
items.desc: Sports physio, rehab and Sports Dietitian integrated directly with coaching — same building, same plan, zero communication gaps.

items.name: NDIS Program
items.desc: Tailored movement and strength programs delivered with genuine expertise and care by qualified professionals.

coaches.body: ASCA and ESSA accredited coaches with real world experience across elite sport, youth development, and rehabilitation. Evidence based, detail driven, and genuinely invested in helping every person progress — from first session to long term results.

hub.body: Coaching. Physio. Rehab. Dietetics. Return to play. All under one roof. All working together — same building, same plan, talking about you.
hub.cardDesc: 35+ years of combined clinical and performance experience. Our physios, coaches, and sports dietitian work together daily, sharing context, communication, and the same performance plan. No referral run around. No mixed messages. Just integrated care and coaching that actually connect

Peta is one of Australia’s leading Sports Dietitians who focuses on maximising performance by proving simple, practical and individualised advice.

Peta has worked with a range of athletes including Olympic Gold Medallists and Premiership winning players. She specialises in Performance Nutrition, Corporate Presenting and Meal Plans.

stories.body: I trained with Marco at ATHLETIX in preparation for my upcoming preseason, and it was one of the best training experiences I’ve had.
I joined Athletix to help my return to sport after a season-ending injury and found a community completely engaged in my development and wellbeing.

I have significantly improved in all aspects of my gym work which has been felt during training on the track.
Love the culture, the atmosphere & the quality of the programming here.

Myself and a few of my team mates at the Brisbane Lions (AFLW) attended weekly mobility sessions with Marco at Athletix Gym, it was absolutely amazing, and helped us unlock new movement and strength as elite athletes
